{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Define sentinel values
sentinel_values = [-999.0, -999, -999.00, -999.000]

# Filter out rows with sentinel values in either baseline or final biomarker
df_clean = df[~df['biomarker_baseline'].isin(sentinel_values) & ~df['biomarker_final'].isin(sentinel_values)]

# Compute the change in biomarker level
df_clean['change'] = df_clean['biomarker_final'] - df_clean['biomarker_baseline']

# Compute the average change
total_change = df_clean['change'].mean()

# Print the result
total_change"}
